Emily (PM): Quick sync — post-launch week 1. We have 8 customer-reported regressions (2 P1, 3 P2) and 3 onboarding UX asks that move the needle on activation. Need a prioritization plan for the next mini-release. Proposal: immediate triage on P1s, allocate a small band for the highest-impact enhancement, and a grooming cadence for the rest. Thoughts?
Sanjay (Eng): Agree with triage. Rough capacity: P1 infra regressions look like 2-3 engineer-weeks total; two of them look like rollout misconfig + one is a caching edge-case. If we block 2 engineers for ~3 days we can clear the critical backlog.
Marta (Design): The onboarding tweaks are lightweight but high-conversion. One designer + one engineer for 2 full days could ship a flagged experiment. I can deliver mocks by EOD tomorrow.
Ava (CS): Customers reporting the UX issue include two paying enterprise customers; one mentioned possible churn if not addressed. If we can offer a beta fix quickly that would buy time.
Ben (SRE): For the infra P1s we should avoid risky broad rollout. Suggest canary + automatic fallback. I'll prepare a rollback playbook. Also need to check our error budget before committing to anything heavy.
Emily (PM): Concrete plan: 1) Immediate triage session today 11:30am PT to confirm severity and owners. 2) Allocate 2 engineers (Sanjay + one) to P1s for first 72 hours. 3) Reserve 1 engineer + Marta for the top onboarding enhancement, ship behind a feature flag and A/B test. 4) Groom remaining items into a follow-on backlog with clear impact estimates. Fallback: if we see additional infra incidents, pause enhancement work and redirect resources to P1s.
Sanjay (Eng): OK. Can we set explicit release criteria for the mini-release so we don't ship regressions?
Emily (PM): Release criteria proposal: - No P1 regressions observed in canary for 24 hours - Error budget consumption < 1% of baseline across canary - No >2% relative regression on the activation funnel in A/B checks (if we roll the enhancement to a test cohort) - All fixes must include a postmortem or follow-up ticket if rolled without full root cause.
Marta (Design): We'll gate the enhancement behind a flag and provide two variants for quick A/B. Prefer a conservative default.
Ava (CS): I'll draft customer comms offering early access and a timeline. Also will escalate the churn-risk customer to AE.
Ben (SRE): Added rollout snippet to the runbook: ```if p99 latency increases >1% or 5xx rate spikes >0.5% over baseline -> abort and rollback; capture traces + inc the oncall.```
deploy-bot: Canary build deployed to staging at 2024-10-12T09:13:21Z :rocket:
Sanjay (Eng): I'll bring exact estimates to the 11:30 triage. Quick note: one P2 is actually a regression introduced by a third-party lib upgrade; that might be a one-line revert.
Emily (PM): Good catch — flag that in triage. Action items: - Emily: run triage meeting 11:30am PT (calendar invite done) - Sanjay: owner for infra fixes + estimates - Marta: mocks & spec by EOD tomorrow - Ava: customer comms + AE escalation - Ben: rollout/runbook snippet + monitoring dashboard to watch - Everyone: add any remaining items to the grooming board before EOD.
Sanjay (Eng): +1. If we clear P1s early, we can widen the enhancement cohort.
Marta (Design): I'll include copy variants for the A/B test.
Ava (CS): I'll prepare a short FAQ for customers.
Emily (PM): Thanks team. Quick ask — please mark items with tags: #p1, #p2, #enhancement, estimated days. We'll surface the priorities in the 11:30 triage and decide the 60/40 split if capacity allows. See you at 11:30. :memo:
